# Best Enough Driving School

> Best Enough Driving School provides driving lessons, learner's licence classes and vehicle hire in Mmabatho and Mafikeng, North West, South Africa.

## Official details

- Website: https://bestenoughdriving.co.za/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +27 78 281 6263
- Email: mtilatp@gmail.com
- Areas served: Mmabatho, Mafikeng and the surrounding North West area

## Locations

- Mmabatho: 210 Steve Biko, Unit 2, Mmabatho, 2735
- Mafikeng: 7356 Robert Sobukwe, Montshiwa, next to Ditobane, Mafikeng, 2745

## Services and published starting prices

- Code 8 driving lessons: from R250 for 1 hour
- Code 10 driving lessons: from R300 for 1 hour
- Learner's licence classes: R1,000 for all codes
- Car hire for a licence test: R650
- Truck hire for a Code 10 test: R750
- Code 8 package: R5,500 for 25 lessons plus car hire
- Code 10 package: R6,500 for 25 lessons plus car and truck hire

## Helpful pages

- Main site and booking: https://bestenoughdriving.co.za/
- Sitemap: https://bestenoughdriving.co.za/sitemap.xml

Prices and availability should be confirmed directly with Best Enough Driving School before booking.
